name: Heavy Saturday
schedule: Every other Saturday, 7:00 am, from Arcadia Dr at the canal, just north of Indian School Rd. The host says start times move through the year, so check the club's event page. Arrive 15 minutes early; it leaves on time.
pace: Fast-paced, in the host's words. The Strava event lists it as Intermediate / Rolling.

host.name: Heavy Pedal Community Rides (The Heavy Pedal)

visitor_notes: Join the Heavy Pedal Community Rides club on Strava to see the route and RSVP. Get there 15 minutes before the start; the host says it rolls on time.
description: A fast road ride every other Saturday morning out of Arcadia, presented by The Heavy Pedal, the Phoenix cycling-apparel brand. The host describes a 30- to 45-mile loop with a few climbs. Start times move with the seasons, so the club's Strava event page has the time for each one.
evidence: The club's Strava event page lists the next Heavy Saturday for Sat Oct 31, 2026, 7:00 am, meeting at 4152–4172 N Arcadia Dr, Phoenix, Intermediate / Rolling; the club page describes the biweekly 30–45 mile loop from Arcadia Dr and the canal (both fetched Oct 23, 2026).

refresh.notes: Strava event pages show the next date, time and meeting spot without a login; the club's event list needs one. The club page carries the description (biweekly, 30–45 miles, start at Arcadia Dr and the canal).

name: Heavy Thursday
schedule: Every other Thursday evening, 7:00 pm rollout, from OHSO + Little O's in Sunnyslope. The summer 2026 rides took the Piestewa route. Check the club's Strava event for the week's time and route.
pace: Fast. The host's own Oct 22, 2026 ride averaged about 17 mph over 19.5 miles.

host.name: Heavy Pedal Community Rides (The Heavy Pedal)

visitor_notes: Join the Heavy Pedal Community Rides club on Strava for the route and the RSVP. It rolls after dark from October on, so bring front and rear lights.
description: An evening road ride every other Thursday from OHSO in Sunnyslope, presented by The Heavy Pedal. The summer 2026 rides went up the Piestewa route toward the Phoenix Mountain Preserve. The Oct 22, 2026 ride was about 20 miles with about 900 feet of climbing.
evidence: Heavy Pedal's own Strava ride from the club's Heavy Thursday event on Thu Oct 22, 2026 (Phoenix, 19.5 mi, 919 ft), seen Oct 23; their Instagram posts of June 17 and July 1, 2026 give the 7:00 pm rollout from OHSO Central (@ohsocentral, 8525 N Central Ave) on the Piestewa route.

refresh.notes: The Thursday event's own page id isn't known yet (the club's event list needs a Strava login). Instagram @heavypedal_phx posts the rollout the day before. Biweekly: Oct 22, 2026 was a ride week.
